xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:NameOfTheCompany: INDIAN RAILWAY CATERING AND TOURISM CORPORATION LIMITED
xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR:
1 The above UFR of IRCTC reviewed by Audit Committee and approved by the BOD at their respective meetings held on 14.11.2022. The Statutory Auditors have conducted limited review of the UFR.
2 The above UFR of IRCTC prepared in accordance with Ind-AS as prescribed u/s 133 of the Companies Act read with Companies (Ind-AS) Rules, 2015, as amended from time to time.
3 Catering contracts awarded before 22.03.2020 have been treated as zero period due to Pandemic & accordingly, no income as well as Rlys share payable has accrued during 2020-21 & for the period up to 26.11.2021. Catering services has been restarted with cooked food from 27.11.2021 in a phased manner & income & Rly share payable has been accrued accordingly. However, the effect of enhancement of LF for the periods from 18.11.2019 to 22.03.2020 and 27.11.2021 to 30.09.2022 has not been ascertained & recognized on account of increase in catering tariff as per CC-60 of 2019 issued by the Rly Board, since due to Pandemic, the sales assessment by the Company was pending which is now in progress.
4 During FY 2021-22, an amt. of Rs.2713.32 lakhs was paid & charged to revenue on account of 15% Rly share in profits of Railneer plants (owned & PPP plants) up to 31.3.2021 as Rlys have not agreed with the contention of the company i.e railneer is part of catering segment which is in loss & also demands 40% revenue share for PPP Plants. No provision was made for the FY 2021-22 in view of the loss incurred in Railneer segment after considering above payment of Rs.2713.32 lakhs as expense for that year. These matters are subject to confirmation and reconciliation with Rlys.
5 As per terms & conditions of tender, in respect of 4 PPP Railneer plants, the DCOs are to be reimbursed the GST on sales net of ITC availed by them. The impact for the same amounting of Rs.309.28 lakhs was accounted for in FY 2021-22 except for one plant where figs. of ITC claimed by DCO were not available. Further, due to non-availability of figs. of ITC claimed by respective DCOs of 02 plants for the half year ending 30.09.2022, the same could not be estimated and accounted in the respective quarters and these DCOs have represented against the claim of IRCTC for ITC. The issues of GST recovery was discussed in the audit committee meeting and the Committee has advised to seek opinion from Solicitor General (SG) on this issue and necessary decision will be taken by IRCTC after the receipt of the said opinion.
6 The Anti Profiteering Authority issued notice dated 25.02.2022 for profiteering amount of Rs. 5041.44 Lakhs u/s 171 of the CGST Act, 2017 for not passing the benefit of tax reduction to consumers. The SCN has contested by the Company and matter was argued in August,2022 but final order from Authority still awaited.
7 Arbitration award was pronounced in April, 2022 amounting to Rs.7400 Lakhs + simple interest @6% pa from July, 2018 onwards, in favour of certain licensees which represents principal amt. towards claims for supply of welcome drinks not paid to licensees & recovery of differential costs for the supply of regular meals to the passengers on the instructions of Rlys whereas the price of combo meal, which is lower than the price of regular meal, was reimbursed to these licensees. The matter has been referred to Rlys for their instructions on the matter as the main liability in this matter would be of Rlys and the Co. has the right to recovery from Rlys in case ultimately it is made liable to pay. The Co. has filed objections against Arbitration award & same was listed before Honorable HC of Delhi on 28.09.2022. The next date of hearing is fixed on 28.03.2023.
8 For FY 2021-22, net Exceptional expenses amounting Rs.400.45 Lakhs includes (i) Rs.2248.54 Lakhs being reversal of excess provisions for previous years relating to PRP, (ii) Rs.2713.32 lakhs being expense on account of 15% Rly share in profits of Railneer plants up to 31.3.2021 (refer Note no.4); & (iii) Rs.64.33 Lakhs being excess provisions written back for previous years relating to various other expenses.
9 During FY 2021-22, the Co. has Sub-divided its 1600 Lakhs equity shares of FV of Rs.10/- each fully paid up into 8000 Lakhs equity shares of FV of Rs.2/- each fully paid up w.e.f. 29.10.2021. EPS have been calculated / restated, as applicable, for all the period(s) presented after considering the new number of equity shares post such sub-division in line with the provisions of the applicable Ind AS and to make figures of EPS comparable with previous periods/year.
10 The fig. for the previous periods have been regrouped/reclassified/restated, wherever considered necessary.
